description: Kinetic directionality of AraM from its published Km values combined with cytoplasmic metabolite pools
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
R=8.314e-3; T=310.15
# Published steady-state constants for AraM (PMID 18558723, as curated in UniProt P94527)
Ka=8.1e-6     # Km DHAP
Kb=16e-6      # Km NADH
Kp=1370e-6    # Km G1P
Kq=59.3e-6    # Km NAD+
print("Km(G1P)/Km(DHAP) = %.0f-fold  ;  Km(NAD+)/Km(NADH) = %.1f-fold" % (Kp/Ka, Kq/Kb))
# cytoplasmic pools (E. coli glucose minimal, PMID 19561621)
A=0.37e-3; B=8.3e-5; Q=2.6e-3
print("\nSaturation state of AraM at measured pools:")
for lbl,c,K in [("DHAP",A,Ka),("NADH",B,Kb),("NAD+",Q,Kq)]:
    print(f"  {lbl:5s} {c*1e6:8.1f} uM  = {c/K:6.2f} x Km  -> fractional saturation {c/(c+K):.2f}")
rows=[]
for dG0 in [-16.9,-21.9,-26.9]:
    Keq=np.exp(-dG0/(R*T))
    VfVr = Keq*(Ka*Kb)/(Kp*Kq)          # Haldane relation for an ordered bi-bi reaction
    for G1P in [1e-5,1e-4,1e-3]:
        flux_ratio = Keq*(A*B)/(G1P*Q)  # forward/reverse one-way flux = Keq / mass-action ratio
        rows.append(dict(dG0=dG0, Keq=round(Keq,1), Vmax_f_over_Vmax_r=round(VfVr,2),
                         G1P_uM=G1P*1e6, forward_over_reverse_flux=round(flux_ratio,1),
                         G1P_over_Km=round(G1P/Kp,3)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("\n"+D.to_string(index=False)); D.to_csv("aram_kinetic_directionality.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
labels=["DHAP\n(forward substrate)","NADH\n(forward cosubstrate)","G1P\n(reverse substrate)","NAD+\n(reverse cosubstrate)"]
Km=[Ka,Kb,Kp,Kq]; pool=[A,B,1e-4,Q]
x=np.arange(4)
ax.bar(x-0.2,[k*1e6 for k in Km],0.4,label="published Km (uM)",color="#888")
ax.bar(x+0.2,[p*1e6 for p in pool],0.4,label="cytoplasmic pool (uM)",color="#2f6f9f")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("concentration (uM, log scale)")
ax.set_title("AraM is saturated with its forward substrates\nand far below Km for G1P",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2=axes[1]
g=np.logspace(-6.5,-2,200)
for dG0,c in zip([-16.9,-21.9,-26.9],["#9ecae1","#2f6f9f","#08306b"]):
    Keq=np.exp(-dG0/(R*T)); ax2.plot(g*1e6, Keq*(A*B)/(g*Q), color=c, label=f"dG'o = {dG0} kJ/mol")
ax2.axhline(1,color="red",ls="--",lw=1); ax2.text(0.4,1.3,"net reversal",color="red",fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xscale("log"); ax2.set_yscale("log")
ax2.set_xlabel("cytoplasmic [G1P] (uM)"); ax2.set_ylabel("forward / reverse one-way flux")
ax2.set_title("Reversal needs G1P in the tens of mM",fontsize=10); ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
